title: 第3章 初级治疗药水
content_zh:
斗破大陆的一大特色便是，所有的玩家八大生活职业都是开启的，你可以自己选择进阶哪个生活职业，而提升生活职业，也是要花大把的元宝的，元宝又需要用人民币兑换，所以大多数人只会进阶一两个生活职业，多了的话，却是玩不起。

而且不同的职业，对于红药、蓝药等需求量不同，一般来讲，一个玩家将两个生活职业作为主修便够了，展飞以前，同样只练种植和炼金两个生活技能。

不过现在的话，这八个职业技能，倘若真的能在现实之中炼制出东西的话，那么以后展飞便有了自己的生财之道了啊！上学是为了什么？有的人是为了祖国的崛起，展飞的话，仅仅是为了赚钱而已。

有了钱，展飞可以帮母亲把租的那个服装店面地盘买下来，有了钱，展飞可以把自己打扮成高富帅，带着学校里的妹子去打针，有了钱，展飞这个冷门的数学专业找工作也没有任何难度了，直接砸出个公务员铁饭碗出来。

所以，钱不是万能的，不过一万件事情里，九千九百九十九件，都是钱能够搞定的，这便是钱的魅力了，而接着，展飞便在种植、狩猎、采矿、剥皮、炼金、烹饪、锻造、裁缝八个生活技能上面巡视了起来。

这八个生活技能，前四个是原料类，后四个是合成类，如今展飞手上什么都没有，自然要选择原料类了，不过，原料类同样需要生产工具的，种植、狩猎、采矿、剥皮四大原料类生活技能。

在寝室里面，展飞还是感觉种植这个技能比较靠谱一些，随即展飞直接便用意念点击了一下商城，然后，一大批琳琅满目的商品出现在了展飞的眼前，而原料类生活技能的生产工具同样也在其中。

很快的，展飞便找到了一级种植术能够种植的植物，一级种植术，能够种植三种植物，分别是血蓟、宁神花、银叶草，三种植物分别有着不同的功效。

血蓟可以炼制出增加攻击上限的血蓟丸，宁神花和银叶草搭配起来，则能够炼制出初级治疗药水，而两者也是极为常见的炼金材料，血蓟，展飞自然不可能去种植了，增加攻击上限的丹药，炼制出来根本没有销路，而且称得上是管制型道具了。

一般来讲，两个成年人打架，双方的攻击和防御都在十左右，所以不适用武器增加攻击的话，不会出什么事情，而血蓟丸能够增加十点攻击上限，而成年人五十点的血量值，使用了血蓟丸，只要攻击五次，就能够杀死对方了。

如果是游戏之中，血蓟丸在低级的时候还是很热门的，现实之中的话，展飞却不敢卖这玩意儿。

而初级治疗药水相比来讲，就好了很多了，治病所用，能够恢复三十到五十点生命值，作用还是比较大的，银叶草种子和宁神花种子种子价值一共是十个元宝，展飞包裹里有二十个元宝票，只能购买两份。

目前展飞还不知道，自己的现金能不能直接兑换元宝呢，所以这元宝票还是要省着点花的，所以展飞直接便购买了一份宁神花和银叶草种子，随即展飞便看到，自己的包裹里面多了两份种子。

而他的眼中也是闪过了一丝激动之色，能不能种植稍后再说，现在就看看，自己脑海之中的游戏产品，能否真的带到现实空间中了，想着，展飞先是睁开了眼睛，然后心中默默道：“取出银叶草种子。”

话音一落，展飞便感觉自己手上一沉，接着展飞的手上便多了一个白色的布袋子，里面就是自己刚才所购买的银叶草种子了。

随即展飞小心的看了一眼自己的两个哥们儿，郭鑫玩游戏正玩的嗨呢，而胖子也是一边抓着自己身上的肥肉，一边用腻的让人想吐的语气和自己的网上女友妮妮在聊着天，全然没有注意到展飞这边的诡异情况。

展飞也是松了一口气，然后又直接将银叶草种子收进了空间里面，然后他便再次闭上了眼睛，等待了三秒钟，展飞眼前便再次出现了刚才的那个面板了，而随即，展飞直接便点进了生活职业那个栏目，然后点击了一下种植的选项。

果然，四个空格出现了，展飞也是用意念操控着，将那两种种子拖进了那个空格里面，然后点击了一下空格下面的种植两个按钮，接下来，那袋种子所在的那个空格，便变成了一小格的田地模样，而展飞也是猛然之间感觉有些疲劳，就好像是忽然跑了十多公里一样。

貌似，游戏里面八项生活技能都是要消耗活力的，展飞如今等级低，属性差，活力上限也很低，他能感觉出来，就这最低级的种植技能，貌似自己一天用上三次，活力值就消耗一空了，不过活力值第二天就会回满，所以展飞也不是很担心。

而开始种植之后，那个空格下面也是出现了一个倒数计时的时间，低级的种子成熟速度是很快的，在展飞八十九级的时候，生活技能也升到了五十级了，当时种植这两种种子只需要十秒钟便能成熟了。

不过如今展飞的生活技能等级不过是一级，所以需要半个小时才能够成熟，而展飞的生活技能熟练度也是显示增加了一，生活技能练起来是很麻烦很费事的，每提升一级，熟练度要求增长十倍。

虽然说种植高等级的植物所得到的熟练度也比低等级的植物多，后者远没有前者的涨幅大，故而用熟练度去升级生活技能，前面几级还好，到了后期，比升级战斗技能还要费事，故而所有人都是直接用经验和元宝直接升级生活技能的。

而接下来，便是漫长的等待了，虽然仅仅是半个小时，但是因为展飞心里面太过急迫，所以感觉像是过了一年一样，终于，看着那半个小时的倒计时终于到了，展飞也是直接点击了收获。

接着，展飞的包裹里面也是多了五十份银叶草和宁神花，随即，他直接点开了炼金技能，随即，一个药壶状的容器出现了，展飞将五十份银叶草和宁神花都是拖了进去，然后直接点下了炼金那个键。

合成类技能和生产类技能可不同，生产类技能，需要消耗不少时间，而且种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆，得到的物品是固定的。

而合成类技能，合成一件产品，只需要一秒钟的时间，五十件产品也仅仅需要五十秒罢了，只不过，出来的东西却不一定了。

就像银叶草和宁神花，虽然大部分时候会成功的炼制初级治疗水，不过有时候，会出现一些或好或坏的变异药品，当然了，展飞还巴不得变异了呢。

因为初级治疗水，是整个斗破大陆里面最低级的丹药了，不过是瞬间恢复二十点HP罢了，随便变异一下，出来的药品都比初级治疗水值钱，不过展飞注定要失望了。

五十秒很快过去了，展飞的包裹里面多了五十粒初级治疗水，没有一份变异的，随即展飞直接便将意念放在了刚刚炼制出来的初级治疗水上面，然后初级治疗水的属性自动浮现在了展飞的面前：基本功效：增加三十到五十点血量，附加功效：小幅度治愈外伤、病患。
content_en:
A major feature of Dou Po Continent is that all eight life professions are enabled for all players. You can choose which life profession to advance to. Upgrading a life profession also costs a lot of ingots, and the ingots need to be exchanged for RMB. Therefore, most people will only advance to one or two life professions. If they are more, they cannot afford it.

Moreover, different professions have different demands for red medicine, blue medicine, etc. Generally speaking, it is enough for a player to major in two life professions. Before Zhanfei, he only practiced two life skills: planting and alchemy.

But now, if these eight professional skills can really be refined in reality, then Zhan Fei will have his own way to make money in the future!What is school for?Some people do it for the rise of their motherland, while Zhanfei does it just to make money.

With money, Zhanfei can help his mother buy the land of the clothing store that he rented. With money, Zhanfei can dress himself up as a rich and handsome man and take the girls in the school to get injections. With money, Zhanfei, an unpopular mathematics major, can find a job without any difficulty, and he can directly become a civil servant.

Therefore, money is not everything, but money can solve 9,999 out of 10,000 things. This is the charm of money. Then, Zhan Fei started to inspect the eight life skills of planting, hunting, mining, skinning, alchemy, cooking, forging, and tailoring.

Of these eight life skills, the first four are raw materials, and the last four are synthetic. Now that Zhanfei has nothing on hand, he naturally has to choose the raw materials. However, the raw materials also need to produce tools, and the four major raw material life skills are planting, hunting, mining, and skinning.

In the dormitory, Zhanfei still felt that the planting skill was more reliable, and then Zhanfei clicked on the mall with his mind. Then, a large number of dazzling products appeared in front of Zhanfei, and the production tools of raw material life skills were also among them.

Soon, Zhan Fei found plants that can be grown with the first-level planting technique. The first-level planting technique can grow three kinds of plants, namely blood thistle, Ningshen flower, and silver leaf grass. Each of the three plants has different effects.

Blood thistle can be used to refine blood thistle pills that increase the attack limit. Ningshen flower and silver leaf grass can be combined to make primary healing potions. Both of them are also very common alchemy materials. Blood thistle is naturally impossible for Zhan Fei to plant. There is no market for the elixir that increases the attack limit after being refined, and it can be called a controlled prop.

Generally speaking, when two adults fight, the attack and defense of both sides are around ten, so if you don't use weapons to increase the attack, nothing will happen. Blood Thistle Pill can increase the attack limit by ten points, and an adult with a health value of fifty points, using Blood Thistle Pill, can kill the opponent with just five attacks.

In a game, Blood Thistle Pills are still very popular at low levels, but in reality, Zhan Fei doesn't dare to sell them.

In comparison, the primary healing potion is much better. It is used to treat diseases and can restore thirty to fifty points of health. The effect is relatively large. The seeds of Silver Leaf Grass and Ningshen Flower are worth ten Yuanbao in total. There are twenty Yuanbao Tickets in Zhanfei's package, and only two can be purchased.

At present, Zhanfei doesn't know whether his cash can be directly exchanged for ingots, so he still has to save some money on the ingot tickets, so Zhanfei directly bought a copy of Ningshen flower and silver leaf grass seeds, and then Zhanfei saw that there were two more seeds in his package.

There was also a flash of excitement in his eyes. We will talk about whether he can plant it later. Now let's see if the game product in his mind can really be brought into the real space. Thinking about it, Zhan Fei first opened his eyes, and then said silently in his heart: "Take out the silver leaf grass seeds."

As soon as he finished speaking, Zhan Fei felt his hand sink, and then there was a white cloth bag in Zhan Fei's hand, which contained the silver leaf grass seeds he had just purchased.

Then Zhan Fei took a careful look at his two buddies. Guo Xin was having a great time playing games, while Fatty was grabbing the fat on his body and chatting with his online girlfriend Nini in a disgusting tone, completely unaware of the strange situation on Zhan Fei's side.

Zhan Fei also breathed a sigh of relief, and then directly put the silver leaf grass seeds into the space. Then he closed his eyes again and waited for three seconds. The panel just now appeared again in front of Zhan Fei. Then, Zhan Fei directly clicked into the life and career column, and then clicked on the planting option.

Sure enough, four spaces appeared, and Zhan Fei also used his mind to control them, dragging the two seeds into the space, and then clicked the two planting buttons under the space. Then, the space where the bag of seeds was located turned into a small field, and Zhan Fei suddenly felt a little tired, as if he had suddenly run more than ten kilometers.

It seems that the eight life skills in the game all consume vitality. Zhanfei is currently at a low level, has poor attributes, and the upper limit of vitality is also very low. He can feel it. With the lowest level planting skill, it seems that he has used up all the vitality points after using it three times a day. However, the vitality points will be full the next day, so Zhanfei is not too worried.

After planting started, a countdown time also appeared under the space. Low-level seeds matured very quickly. When Zhanfei reached level 89, his life skills had also risen to level 50. At that time, planting these two seeds only took ten seconds to mature.

However, Zhan Fei's life skill level is only level one now, so it takes half an hour to mature. Zhan Fei's life skill proficiency is also shown to have increased by one. Life skills are very troublesome and time-consuming to practice. For each level, the proficiency requirement increases tenfold.

Although the proficiency obtained by planting high-level plants is more than that of low-level plants, the latter is far less than the former. Therefore, proficiency is used to upgrade life skills. The first few levels are fine, but in the later stages, it is more troublesome than upgrading combat skills. Therefore, everyone directly uses experience and ingots to directly upgrade life skills.

And then there was a long wait. Although it was only half an hour, Zhan Fei was so anxious that it felt like a year had passed. Finally, seeing that the half-hour countdown had finally arrived, Zhan Fei directly clicked on the harvest.

Then, Zhan Fei's package also contained fifty copies of Silver Leaf Grass and Ningshen Flower. Immediately, he clicked on the alchemy skill. Then, a medicine pot-shaped container appeared. Zhan Fei dragged fifty copies of Silver Leaf Grass and Ningshen Flower into it, and then directly clicked on the alchemy button.

Synthetic skills and production skills can be different. Production skills require a lot of time, and you will reap what you sow, and the items you get are fixed.

As for synthesis skills, it only takes one second to synthesize one product, and it only takes fifty seconds to synthesize fifty products. However, what comes out is not necessarily the same.

Just like Silver Leaf Grass and Ningshen Flower, although most of the time they can successfully refine primary healing water, sometimes, some good or bad mutant medicines will appear. Of course, Zhan Fei is eager to mutate.

Because the primary healing water is the lowest elixir in the entire Dou Po Continent. It only restores 20 points of HP instantly. If you mutate it casually, the resulting medicine will be more valuable than the primary healing water, but Zhan Fei is doomed to be disappointed.

Fifty seconds passed quickly, and Zhan Fei's package contained fifty grains of primary healing water, none of which were mutated. Then Zhan Fei directly focused his thoughts on the newly refined primary healing water, and then the properties of the primary healing water automatically appeared in front of Zhan Fei: basic effect: increase blood volume by thirty to fifty points, additional effect: slightly heal trauma and patients.
